Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:13684
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9522 of 2023
Applicant :- Rohit

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant around two years ago, subsequently, entire matrimonial family had killed the daughter of the informant.
As per the post mortem report, on the analysis of the viscera the cause of death is shown as Chlorpyrifos insecticide.

In the post mortem report four contusion injuries are seen over the face,
chick, neck and elbow.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 13.03.2023.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
Rohit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Rohit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. Considering the fact that there is nothing on record to demonstrate that soon before the death,
the deceased was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to the demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 13.03.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Rohit be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 138 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Dehat, District Hardoi, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.2.2024 Arun  Rohit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Home Lko. on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175027570/
